display_name: Bond DV01 (Price Value of a Basis Point)
purpose: DV01 / price value of a basis point for a standard even-period bullet bond, computed by full central-difference reprice at yield plus and minus a declared basis-point shock, not the linear modified-duration approximation. Stays accurate for large coupons or short maturities where the linear approximation drifts. Same bond schedule builder as compute_bond_duration.
